datasets.title: Bangladesh - Cox Bazar Education Facilities Damage Reports
datasets.description: This data is about damage assessment of education facilities of Cox's Bazar during assessment phase in 2018. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cox-bazar-education-facilities-damage-reports]

lineage.description: Education facilities in Cox's Bazar were assessed for damage through sample survey methodology, with damage reports compiled weekly from July to September 2018. The dataset captures post-event structural damage to school buildings, likely triggered by the 2017-2018 monsoon flooding and humanitarian crisis in the region.
